info.title: AIContext CLI
info.description: CLI tool for the AIContext open format standard.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings (missing recommended files, possible secrets) as errors.

options.name: --layout
options.description: single (default): one file per tool. split: small always-on file plus separate scoped/on-demand rule files.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files that were not generated by aicontext.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be written without changing any file.

options.name: --check
options.description: Like --dry-run, but exit with code 1 if any file is missing or out of date (for CI).
